name: Dimitrios Katsaros
bio:
Dimitrios Katsaros' journey into motorsport began with a childhood fascination for aerodynamics, fueled by countless hours spent observing planes take off near his hometown. This early interest led him to pursue a degree in Aerospace Engineering, specializing in computational fluid dynamics. After graduating, he honed his skills in the aerospace industry before transitioning to motorsport, drawn by the dynamic and competitive nature of racing. Dimitrios approaches his role as Head of Aero with a meticulous and data-driven mindset, always seeking marginal gains through rigorous analysis and simulation. His ability to remain calm under pressure and his collaborative approach make him a valuable asset to any team. 

His unique approach lies in blending traditional aerodynamic principles with cutting-edge simulation techniques, constantly pushing the boundaries of what's possible within the regulations. Dimitrios believes that a strong team environment, open communication, and a willingness to experiment are crucial for success in the fast-paced world of motorsport. He continually strives to foster a culture of innovation and learning within his team, ensuring that they remain at the forefront of aerodynamic development.
